purpose: Auditor-independent source-equivalent check of the released CPO mask_loss aggregation algebra. This checker did not import the clean worker script and did not execute DeepSpeed.

independent_method.implementation: NumPy-only reimplementation of the published partition formula and logging scalar; no torch/deepspeed/worker-code dependency

algebra.per_tensor_rank_partial: l_ir = sum_{j in R_i intersect P_r} |theta_ij-ref_ij| / |R_i|
algebra.partition_identity: Because P_r are disjoint and cover all valid parameter positions, sum_r l_ir = sum_{j in R_i}|theta_ij-ref_ij|/|R_i|.
algebra.released_zero3_log: lambda * mean_r(sum_i l_ir) = full_masked_L1 / W, up to floating-point summation error.
algebra.zero2_unsharded_log: Each rank computes the full scalar, so mean across replicated ranks preserves the full scalar.

scope_guard: This establishes source-level aggregation algebra only. It is not pinned PyTorch 2.8.0 + DeepSpeed 0.16.4 distributed execution, does not authenticate historical TensorBoard event files, and does not test or repair the separate regularizer-gradient scaling path.
